Network.Description: All stations from the LIGO sites in the USA, i.e. Hanford and Livingston. Hanford houses two BRSsensors collocated with STS2 at the external ends of the lIGO arms, plus a single STS2 at the internal corner. Livingston houses 4 BRS sensors with collocated STS-2, at both ends (external &internal) of each LIGO arm.[elevation, HAN, LIV] Althouse, W.E., Hand, S.D., Jones, L.K., Lazzarini, A., Weiss, R.. 2001, Precision alignment of the LIGO 4km arms using the dual-frequency differential global positioning.
